system.description:
As a shock trooper, one of the most fundamental elements of training lies in your armor and how to use it on the battlefield. If you are wearing heavy armor when you rage, you gain resistance to Fire and Radiant damage as you use the reinforced plates to defend yourself from incoming fire. If you are wearing medium, light, or no armor, you are instead able to take the dash action as a bonus action on your turn.

In addition, your @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-class-features.Item.9txksq0xfe5sgspl]{Furious Criticals} class feature now applies to ranged attacks so long as the weapon used meets all other requirements.
